title: Constant-Source Prefix Output
statement: For every natural number $C$ and Boolean word $s$, consider the machine that copies its Boolean input to the output and then emits one true symbol for each of $C$ additional steps. Starting from the specified bank configuration with this machine, input $s$, its initial state, and empty output, after $C+1$ steps the machine is halted and the output consists of exactly $C$ copies of true.
